However, replies may not be sent or received if addresses are mistyped, if there is a disruption in the network, or for other reasons. - In the case an incorrect email address was typed when registration was made or an order was placed There are many cases where email addresses are typed using double-byte characters, or where addresses are entered with the wrong domain name. - In the case of security and anti-virus software Some settings may cause replies from us to be determined as spam. ■ It may take a few days or more until a reply is made or a reply cannot be made depending on the inquiry. In addition, we cannot accept requests that we make replies at specific times.
